item.title: ULI India Expands Annual Conference 2026 with Focus on Leadership, Policy and Resilient Cities
item.description: ULI India’s 2026 Annual Conference will bring together global and domestic leaders to examine policy, capital and innovation shaping the future of Indian cities.

item.title: Goa Carnaval 2026 Begins with Grand Curtain Raiser in Porvorim
item.description: Goa Carnaval 2026 began in Porvorim with a traditional bullock cart procession led by King Momo, setting the stage for five days of celebrations across the State.

item.title: Ruffles NBA All-Star Celebrity Game: Badshah Makes Debut at Star-Studded Showcase in Los Angeles
item.description: Badshah debuted at the 2026 Ruffles NBA All-Star Celebrity Game in Los Angeles, joining global athletes and entertainers for the All-Star Weekend showcase.

item.title: MAPIC India Shopping Centre Summit & Awards 2026 to Convene Industry Leaders on 8 April
item.description: MAPIC India Shopping Centre Summit & Awards 2026 will bring retail and real estate leaders to New Delhi on April 8 to examine reforms, rising consumption and new investment opportunities.

item.title: Hexagon Events Successfully Executed TotalEnergies Industrial and Aftermarket Sales Convention at Ramoji Film City
item.description: Hexagon Events Pvt Ltd delivered the six-day TotalEnergies Industrial and Aftermarket Sales Convention at Ramoji Film City, managing multi-group conferences and award nights within a tight timeline.

item.title: WOW Awards Asia 2026 Is Back for Its 17th Edition to Reunite Events & Experiential Industry Leaders in Mumbai
item.description: WOW Awards Asia 2026 returns to Mumbai for its 17th edition, bringing together leaders from experiential marketing, MICE, weddings and live entertainment.

item.title: Chennai Comic Con Wraps Up Packed Weekend, Draws Over 45,000 Fans to Celebrate Fandom
item.description: Chennai Comic Con 2026 drew over 45,000 fans to the Chennai Trade Centre, with international creators, cosplay championships and live performances anchoring the two-day celebration.

item.title: Via Veda Hosts Landmark Maha Shivratri Bhajan Jamming Night at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, Drawing Thousands
item.description: Via Veda drew thousands to Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium for its Maha Shivratri Bhajan Jamming Night, blending devotional music, ritual offerings and digital engagement in a large-scale spiritual gathering.

item.title: Mahindra Blues Festival 2026 Unites Global Blues Icons at Mehboob Studios
item.description: The 14th Mahindra Blues Festival turned Mehboob Studios into a two-day celebration of global blues, featuring Matt Schofield, Shemekia Copeland, Eric Gales and a collaborative All-Star Jam finale.

item.title: Former Spotify India Editorial Head Aoneha Tagore Launches Artist Management Firm Collabor8
item.description: Former Spotify India Head of Editorial Aoneha Tagore has launched Collabor8 Agency, a new artist management and brand advisory firm focused on long-term career development.
